hazard: Lack of support at high risk
theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Anthony Preston
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Mr Preston had demonstrated, in his early return from home leave in the first few days of November, that living at home was a source of substantial stress, and likely to cause him severe anxiety and deepen his depression.
concerns.hazard: living at home causing severe anxiety and depression

concerns.quote: The system for discharge of patients, whereby a nurse makes contact with (in this case) the Leicestershire Crisis Team does not appear to have been robust. There was no documentary proof of the telephone call.
There was no immediate follow up by e mail or fax to the Crisis Team to notify the discharge, and the fact that Mr Preston was at high risk because of the anxiety created when he was living at home.
concerns.hazard: lack of immediate follow up to notify discharge

concerns.quote: As aresult, Mr Preston and his main carer | left without support at a time when he was at high risk
concerns.hazard: lack of support at high risk

reports.title: Christopher Larsen: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: I am concerned about the Leicestershire Partnership NHS Trust MDT meetings and their functionality
The MDT meeting therefore proceeded, and made decisions based upon, incorrect information
concerns.hazard: incorrect information in multidisciplinary team documentation

concerns.quote: The Trust's SI report states that it was "unclear why it was felt the risks had subsided by the time of discharge on 3.12.2022"
concerns.hazard: unclear risk assessment rationale at discharge

concerns.quote: there was no planned support for Mr Larsen post-discharge other than some counselling which was due to start three weeks later
concerns.hazard: lack of post-discharge support for high-risk patient

concerns.quote: I remain concerned about inadequacies in the Serious Incident Investigation and Reporting processes at Leicestershire Partnership NHS Trust
it failed to uncover all the matters arising at inquest and, some of the matters that it did uncover do not have correlating items of work listed in the action plan
concerns.hazard: incomplete action plan for serious incident investigation

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that patients assessed as high risk were discharged without adequate post‑discharge support, leaving them vulnerable. The earlier case involved missing documentation of a crisis team call; the later case involved absent planned support and questionable risk downgrading.
links.earlier_quote: (4) As aresult, Mr Preston and his main carer | left without support at a time when he was at high risk.
links.later_quote: Discharge Mr Larsen was discharged from the care of LPT on 3 December 2022, there was no planned support for Mr Larsen post-discharge other than some counselling which was due to start three weeks later.
